region, Will using AI affect rapport with my patients?

Most clinicians find the opposite. When you're not typing, patients feel more heard, not less. The disclosure at the start of the consult is brief and matter-of-fact. You can also choose not to listen in session and dictate afterward. Either way, Heidi formats your note the same way.
